tourSteps.title: SYNC MODE
tourSteps.text: Hi! Let's start by picking your visibility. Anonymous for a mysterious start, or Public to let your unique Avatar shine!

tourSteps.title: YOUR ROLE
tourSteps.text: Who are you today? A Seeker looking for support, or a Supporter ready to listen? Tell me your heart's current role.

tourSteps.title: WHAT DO YOU NEED?
tourSteps.text: What do you need most right now? A quick Vent, some Advice, or just a quiet Companion? I'll help filter the right vibes.

tourSteps.title: SET YOUR RESONANCE
tourSteps.text: Choose the Emotional Frequency you're on. Whether it's Joy or Awkward, we'll find someone truly on your wavelength.

tourSteps.title: INTENSITY
tourSteps.text: How deep should we go? Adjust the Intensity—from a light-hearted chat to a deep, soulful conversation. You're in control.

tourSteps.title: TOPIC
tourSteps.text: Lastly, pick a Topic if you have something specific. If not, 'General' is perfect for a serendipitous encounter!

returningUserCatchphrases.BLUSHY: Oh... you're back. Don't feel rushed, let's just find someone who makes you feel comfortable.
returningUserCatchphrases.BLUEY: Welcome back. Let's look for a soul that understands the quiet moments as much as you do.
returningUserCatchphrases.GRUMPY: Back again? Good. Let's find someone who's worth your time and won't give you any nonsense.
returningUserCatchphrases.SCAREDY: You're here! I was just getting a bit anxious... let's find a safe and kind person to talk to.
returningUserCatchphrases.SNOOZY: Hey... no need to overthink the settings. Let's just find a chill vibe and take it easy.
returningUserCatchphrases.SUNNY: Yay! You're back! I've got a great feeling about today—let's find you an amazing match!
returningUserCatchphrases.ZIPPY: Ready for action? Let's calibrate your resonance and get you connected immediately!
returningUserCatchphrases.YUCKY: Welcome back. Remember, your energy is a gift—only match with those who truly deserve it.
returningUserCatchphrases.SPARKLE: Back to the search? Let's find a connection that helps us reflect and grow together.
